items: STEPLESS DIMMABLE LAMP - You can turn on/off and turn up/dim the lights by rotating the dimmer knob. The operation is simple and suitable for people of any age. USB-C & USB & AC OUTLET CHARGING PORTS - Each farmhouse nightstand lamp integrates with a USB-C port, a USB port and a 2-prong AC outlet (5V/2.1A), which are available for use whether the black table lamps set of 2 are on or off. With that you'll have an easy access to charge mobile phones, tablets, kindle readers, e-watch, mini-humidifier and others

TWO 6W LED BULBS INCLUDED - You will receive two 6W E26 LED bulbs which worth $12, bonus but high quality, no flickering, no buzzing and less heat output. It has a bright light and easy on the eyes, rated to last 25,000 hours. And it is perfectly suitable to use the thomas edison lamp as bright desk lamps for home office

MODERN DESIGN FOR INDUSTRY STYLE - Adopted thick cylinder glass shade, pairs with rust-proof matte black finish iron, these rustic bedside lamps set of 2 perfectly combine a touch of vintage style with modern industry design, suitable for decorating anywhere in home and office, such as bedroom, living room, dorm, guest room, kids room, and also perfect gift choice for festivals, birthday and housewarming

INNQOO'S WORK WITH SINCERITY - As a 6-year old store, we have been committed to providing customers with the most suitable lighting fixtures. The bedroom lamps for nightstand set of 2 are the modern aesthetic decor that we have newly developed to give back to our customers. If any problems arise, please contact us, we will ensure that you receive new and intact lamps!
